beats.text: Armenia has 100% urban sanitation access. In DR Congo, only 21.8% of people have it.
This counts people using improved sanitation facilities that are not shared with other households.
Israel, Kuwait and Chile are at 100%. They have universal access for all urban residents.
India is at 87.4%. Nigeria is lower, at 59.1%.
DR Congo sits at the bottom at 21.8%.
Armenia has 4.6 times the access that DR Congo has.
Does your neighborhood have access to a private, improved toilet?
